int_name: N BROAD ST & W ONTARIO ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban street with significant vehicle traffic and institutional buildings. While sidewalks are present, the environment is dominated by motor vehicles, and clear pedestrian crossing infrastructure like marked crosswalks or signals is not visible in the immediate foreground.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicles
hazards.description: The large SUV and truck in the foreground block the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lanes.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a long distance without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross, helping pedestrians make informed decisions.

result.summary: This wide urban intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes without a median refuge island increases pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles parked near the intersection corner can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, white truck parked near the corner

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface could present minor trip hazards or affect vehicle stopping distances.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and 'No Turn on Red' signage to enhance safety. However, the wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a central refuge island, increasing their exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Turning Vehicle Conflicts
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for vehicle turns that may conflict with pedestrians, despite the presence of warning signs.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where vehicles turn onto or from Ontario St

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide sidewalks and curb ramps near an institutional building, but lacks essential crossing infrastructure. There are no visible crosswalk markings or pedestrian signals at this intersection, and parked vehicles along the curb may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a curb ramp and high-volume institutional land use, there are no painted crosswalk markings to alert drivers to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway area adjacent to the red tactile paving.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right side of the street can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway where cars are parked.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven pavement in the roadway can create tripping hazards or cause vehicles to swerve.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the asphalt roadway.
